النسيان مش عيب في عقلك؛ ده نظام حماية. ع: Forgetting is not a defect in your mind; This is a protection system. German psychologist Hermann Ebbinghaus discovered more than a century ago that we lose about 70% of new information within 24 hours if we do not review it. But his research also revealed a powerful solution: distributing reviews at increasing intervals. When you review a word after a day, then 3 days, and then a week, your brain receives a signal that this information is important and transfers it to long-term memory. Modern applications have automated this technique, called spaced repetition. Students who use it can memorize thousands of words with just twenty minutes of daily practice. The lesson is clear: studying harder is not the solution; Studying at the right time is the solution.
